description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentAPI class, which manages CRUD operations for interview attachment entities within a recruitment plugin for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interview attachments via RESTful endpoints, utilizing request parameters and data validation. The class interacts with data access objects and related services, and incorporates OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD endpoints for managing interview attachments in the recruitment module, with methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting attachments, supplemented by OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all interview attachments, applying filters and pagination, and returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new interview attachment, processing request data and saving the entity.

methods.name: setInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Sets the properties of an InterviewAttachment entity from request parameters, particularly the interview ID and comment.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves the interview ID from request parameters.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Populates an InterviewAttachment entity with file data received in Base64 format, including filename, type, size, and content.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, ensuring correct parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified interview attachments based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interview attachment by ID, for display or download.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing interview attachment, optionally replacing its file content based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts an InterviewAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for external use.
